        # Return the corrected ISBN number

    for j in range(1, m + 1):

            if n == 1:

            # If the student is not the only one in the circle, calculate the number of passing ways

                dp[i][j] = dp[(i - 1) % n][j - 1] + dp[(i + 1) % n][j - 1]

    # Return the number of passing ways for the last student
